senses.gloss: f.(b. h. pl. קְשָׂוֹת; cmp. כָּסָה I)marked measure, esp. vessel for libation.
units: Snh. IX, 6 הגונב את הק׳ (Y. ed. הקסווא) if one steals the ḳisvah, expl. ib. 81ᵇ מאי ק׳ כלי שרת (Ms. M. קיסווא) ḳ. means service vessels (ref. to Num. IV, 7); Y. ib. IX, end, 27ᵇ, v. קִיסְטָא II. Bab. ib. 82ᵇ.
Tosef. Zeb. I, 12 היין שניסכו בקיסוא וכ׳ ed. Zuck. (Var. בקסווה) if wine for libation was poured into the ḳ. and thence into a hin measure.—Pl. קִסְוָואוֹת, קִשְׂוָו׳.

<cite ref="Sukkah 48b">Succ. 48ᵇ</cite> <he>שני קס׳ וכ׳</he> (sub. <he>מיני</he>) ed. Pes. a. oth. (Ms. M. 1 <cite ref="S02222"><he>קִשְׂוָא׳</he></cite>; Ms. M. 2 <cite ref="S01632"><he>קְסָאוֹת</he></cite>; ed. <he>קשוו׳</he>) two sets of bowls were there, one for water, and one for wine libations.
